app.tagline: Understand it. Don't just memorize it.

signin.title: Welcome to Lumo
signin.subtitle: Turn your notes into quizzes that help you truly understand.
signin.privacy: We never show your email or real name to other students.

errors.wrong_code: That code is wrong or expired.
errors.invalid_code: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.
errors.network: Can't reach Lumo. Check your connection.

home.streakNone: Study today to light your first streak flame.
home.streakSafe: Your streak is safe today. Lumo is glowing!
home.streakAtRisk: Study today to keep your {{count}}-day streak!
home.streakBroken: Your streak went out. Let's light a new one!
home.createBody: Send photos of your notes and tell me about your exam.
home.reviewBody: Practice, review and fix mistakes — new questions every time.
home.sandboxBody: Videos, podcasts, puzzles, escape rooms… any format you like.
home.chestsWaiting_one: You have a chest to open!
home.adoptPetBody: Pets cheer you on and give a small XP bonus.

profile.title: My profile
profile.usernameHint: 3–20 letters, numbers or _. No real names or birth years.

errors.username_personal_info: Keep personal info (like birth years) out of your username.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Your uploads are only used to make your decks. You can delete everything at any time.
settings.deleteConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, decks and progress. Type DELETE to confirm.

learn.title: My decks
learn.emptyBody: Send Lumo photos of your notes and it will build a deck and quiz for you — or try a sample deck.

deck.notFound: This deck doesn’t exist (or isn’t yours).
deck.practiceBody: A fresh mix of questions, new every time.
deck.challengeBody: Wrong answers cost a heart. Show what you know!
deck.noHearts: No hearts left — do a Review to refill.
deck.masteryRule: A concept is mastered when you’ve got it right in 3 different question types, at more than one level of depth.

quiz.notQuite: Not quite — let’s learn from it
quiz.retrySoon: You’ll see this idea again soon, asked a different way.
quiz.teachPlaceholder: Explain it to Lumo like a friend…
quiz.explainPlaceholder: Write it in your own words…
quiz.ownWords: Your own words count — no need to match the textbook.
quiz.dragHint: Drag each item to the right place — or tap it, then tap where it goes.
quiz.allPlaced: All placed! Tap an item to move it.
quiz.orderHint: Drag the steps, or use the arrows, to put them in order.
quiz.tapMistakeFirst: First tap the part that’s wrong
quiz.sessionDoneBody: Every question was new — that’s how real understanding grows.
quiz.outOfHeartsBody: No worries! Do a Review session to refill hearts — learning never stops.

errors.no_hearts: No hearts left. Try a Review session to refill them.
errors.no_questions: Couldn’t make questions for this deck.
errors.invalid_answer: That answer couldn’t be read. Try again.
errors.network: Can’t reach Lumo. Check your connection.

chat.title: Make a deck with Lumo
chat.subtitle: Photos, PDFs or text → the important ideas → a deck and quiz.
chat.placeholder: Message Lumo… e.g. “science test Friday on cells”
chat.ignored: {{n}} things I left out (not exam material)
chat.draftSnapshot: Earlier version of the deck plan
chat.sugWrong: Quiz me on what I got wrong
chat.consent1: Your photos and files are only used to make your study deck.
chat.consent2: They’re deleted as soon as your deck is built.
chat.consent3: Don’t upload photos of people or personal documents.

errors.file_too_large: That file is too big (max 15 MB).
errors.unsupported_file: I can read photos, PDFs and text files.
errors.consent_required: Please accept the upload notice first.
errors.empty_message: Write something or attach your notes.
errors.invalid_draft: Something in the deck isn’t valid — check the titles and meanings.
errors.network: Can’t reach Lumo. Check your connection.

sandbox.title: Study Sandbox
sandbox.subtitle: Study any way you like — every format makes you think.
sandbox.needDeck: Make a deck first (send Lumo your notes), then pick any format here.

desc.video: Narrated animation that pauses for you to predict.
desc.podcast: Lumo & Nova discuss it — with quick checks.
desc.story: Solve a mystery by using the ideas.
desc.crossword: Clues are meanings, answers are terms.
desc.word_search: Find the hidden terms from their clues.
desc.memory: Flip cards to match terms and meanings.
desc.scramble: Unscramble the letters to find the term.
desc.quiz_show: Pick categories and points, deeper = more.
desc.escape_room: Answer to get each digit of the code.
desc.speed_round: 60 seconds of true or false. Go!
desc.two_truths: Catch the lie hiding among the facts.
desc.flashcards: Think, flip, and be honest with yourself.
desc.mind_map: See how it all connects, then test it.
desc.cheat_sheet: One printable page — with a self-test.
desc.timeline: Follow the steps, then rebuild them.

sandbox.notForDeck: Not possible with this deck’s notes.
sandbox.wordSearchHint: Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
sandbox.memoryHint: Match each term with its meaning
sandbox.speedIntro: {{s}} seconds. True or false — as many as you can!
sandbox.fooled: Fooled you! That one is true.
sandbox.escapeRules: {{rooms}} rooms · {{min}} minutes. Wrong answers cost time, not the game.
sandbox.cardsDone: You knew {{n}} of {{total}} on the first try.
sandbox.thinkFirst: Say the meaning out loud before flipping!
sandbox.tapNode: Tap any idea to see what it means.
sandbox.selfTestHint: Recall each meaning in your head, then tap to check.
sandbox.rebuild: Use “{{acronym}}” to rebuild the list in order:
sandbox.good: Nice work! A bit more practice and you’ve got it.
sandbox.keepGoing: Good start — every try builds your memory.

errors.unknown_format: I didn’t catch the format — try “video”, “crossword”, “escape room”…
errors.format_not_possible: That format doesn’t work with these notes — try another one!
errors.network: Can’t reach Lumo. Check your connection.

league.title: {{tier}} League
league.notJoined: You haven’t joined this week’s league yet
league.notJoinedBody: Earn XP to join a group of up to 30 learners at your level.
league.globalEmpty: Nobody has earned XP this week yet. Be the first!
league.rules: Each week, the top learners move up a league, the bottom ones move down. Only XP from real studying counts.

streak_freeze.name: Streak freeze
streak_freeze.desc: Protects your streak for one missed day.

heart_refill.name: Heart refill
heart_refill.desc: Fills all your hearts right away.

pet_food.name: Pet snack
pet_food.desc: Feeds your pet and helps it grow.

egg_rare.name: Rare egg
egg_rare.desc: Hatches a rare, epic or legendary pet.

shop.title: Shop
shop.noChests: No chests yet — earn them from levels, quests and leagues.
shop.noItems: Nothing here yet. Earn coins by studying!
shop.used_egg: Your egg hatched! Meet your new pet on the Pets page.

errors.not_enough_coins: Not enough coins yet — study a bit more!
errors.max_freezes: You can hold at most 3 streak freezes.
errors.cannot_repair: This streak can’t be repaired anymore.

pets.title: My pets
pets.adoptBody: Your pet cheers you on. Keep your streak going and feed it to keep it happy — a happy pet gives you a small XP bonus.
pets.tip: Pets get sad if your streak breaks. Study every day to keep them happy!

moodLine.happy: Is so proud of your streak!
moodLine.content: Is ready to study with you.
moodLine.hungry: Is getting hungry — time for a snack?
moodLine.sad: Misses you. Study today to cheer it up!

errors.not_enough_items: No snacks left — get some in the shop.
